first_encounter_X: The headline promises local p99 regression diagnosis. The adjacent 340 ms, 42 MB, and zero outbound bytes give engineers concrete reasons to look closer. The next section shows a failed CI gate and the SQL span responsible.
first_encounter_Y: The headline makes the local p99 use case clear. The runtime panel answers deployment and data-handling questions and links directly to the trace demo. The dark demo is the strongest visual focal point below the hero.
evidence: X has the stronger decision sequence. It puts quantitative proof in the hero, then moves from diagnosis to the four-step workflow before expanding into architecture, benchmarks, and adoption. Y makes the mechanisms easier to scan. Its waterfall pairs baseline and candidate bars with visible deltas and a 120 ms marker, its inspector ties the regression to SQL and a source line, and its architecture section gives ingestion and CI gating distinct visual examples. X's regression and fixed-state controls are a useful affordance. Y gives the demo more focal weight, uses more legible secondary copy, and varies the density of its feature section. Interaction behavior cannot be verified from either screenshot.
